thread:
remo: heads-up bringing polarion9b (9B) into int4 pipeline. saw a neat "token shadowing" issue where combining diacritics change token ids -> kv-cache miss + rotary phase misalign.

tara: snippet?

remo: pasted minimal repro: 
```bash
# normalise with nfkc vs nfkc_cf
python -c "print(tokenizer.encode('e\u0301'))"  # returns [134, 5]
python -c "print(tokenizer.encode('é'))"         # returns [42]
```
This means same user-visible char maps to different ids depending on normalizer. on fp16 we had postprocess that NFKC'd input; converter didn't record normalizer.

ken: oof. that'll shift sentinel/sep positions in kvstream. Did you also see rotary problems?

remo: yes, after fixing tokenizer mapping, there's still a 3% QA degrade. I dumped sin/cos basis and noticed head-order permutation vs our loader: model uses "rotary_freq_permute=even_first". converter flattened it away.

onboard-bot: ONBOARD: polarion9b-int4 -> SMOKE_FAILED (QA delta > threshold). Ticket INF-5012 created.

tara: So root causes: 1) missing normalizer info in manifest 2) dropped rotor permute flag 3) quant flip increased sensitivity.

lucy: Proposed short fixes: a) add 'token_normalizer' field to manifest (values: "nfkc|nfkc_cf|none"); b) persist 'rotary_meta': "permute=even_first|odd_first|none", "scale=per_head|global"; c) add a small onboarding probe that compares tokenization invariants and per-head sin/cos ordering against fp16.

ken: Could we also add a lightweight end-to-end smoke: sample with combining diacritics + accentfold and assert identical token ids after manifest-normalizer applied? Save us from silent drift.

remo: added quick patch locally. With token_normalizer set to nfkc_cf and reapplying rotary permute shim, QA F1 restores to fp16 baseline +-0.6%. Will open PRs.

onboard-bot: PR opened: manifest-token-normalizer-and-rotary-meta (#1183)

tara: add to runbook: how to triage token shadowing: 1) check token id diffs for NFKC variants 2) confirm sentinel/sep ids 3) dump per-head sin/cos pairs 4) emulate quantized forward with fp16 rotary ordering.

remo: thanks. i'll push PR + CI link shortly. cc @ken for loader shim review :thumbsup:
